name: Ayush jain
player_statement:
A complete player, Ayush jain has made a big mark in cricket. With 26 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 47, with an average of 12.05 and a quick strike rate of 109.05. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 18 sixes and 12 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 33.0 overs, taking 10 wickets at an economy rate of 7.97. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
